grants.description: Verify employee identity to process carer's leave request
grants.purpose: To confirm the identity of the employee making the carer's leave request

grants.description: Access employment records to verify eligibility and entitlement
grants.purpose: To calculate entitlement and verify the employee hasn't exceeded their annual allowance

grants.description: Provide details of the carer's leave request
grants.purpose: To process the statutory carer's leave request and maintain accurate leave records

grants.description: Declare information about the dependant requiring care (no evidence required by law)
grants.purpose: To confirm the request meets statutory criteria for carer's leave

revocation.mechanism: Contact HR department or withdraw request through employer system
revocation.effect: Request will be cancelled if consent is revoked before approval

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide false information about care needs. Agent cannot override notice period requirements. Agent cannot force employer to approve request. Final approval decision rests with employer after assessment.
